prompt: I need a shopkeeper for an apothecary in the Silver District of Thalyra. Low detail is fine.

assertions.text: Output is a Markdown file under the outputs/ directory
Lore section is short (Low detail: roughly 2-8 lines, not multi-paragraph)
A 5e 2014 stat block is present with AC, HP, Speed, and the six ability scores (STR/DEX/CON/INT/WIS/CHA)
Stat block has a Challenge rating listed (any CR is fine since user didn't specify)
Stat block's Proficiency Bonus matches its CR per 2014 rules (CR 0-4 = +2)
Output includes [[Thalyra]] as an Obsidian wiki-link (not plain text)
Output references the Silver District (district name appears, ideally linked if a Silver District file exists)
Output mentions or implies apothecary/alchemical work in the role
